## Problem and result

Explain the task, the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue and relevant upstream work if available.

## Checks

State the command, result and any skip. Separate fixture checks, native window checks and real device receipt. List open checks without claiming acceptance.

- [ ] Ran `./scripts/validate.sh` and `python3 .github/check_doc_links.py`, or explained why not.
- [ ] Updated the owning help text/link and contract when behavior changed.
- [ ] Checked keyboard routes, disabled reasons and plain-text state for a UI change.
- [ ] Kept provider policy, pairing trust and local appearance separate.
- [ ] Added no credentials, personal state or unlicensed assets; kept upstream attribution.

## Review notes

Name any compatibility, permission, migration or recovery concern. Use `git commit -s` for new contributions when possible; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
